# SOOS — Intent Declaration Primitive (IDP)
# draft-sato-soos-idp-05
# https://soosproject.ai/drafts/idp/llms.txt
# Author: Tom Sato / MyAuberge K.K.
# Last updated: July 2026

---

## SECTION 1 — Canonical One-Liner

IDP (Intent Declaration Primitive) defines the structured, cryptographically committed declaration of intent that an AI agent submits to the GEC before each action executes. IDP-05 adds: intake_endorsement (GEC operation that produces a signed Endorsed EOD before session initiation; endorsed_eod_id required in IDPs for Class 3 agents); PD-EOD (Prompt-Derived EOD branch for natural-language-driven sessions, with scope-bounding rule and HEM notification for external-system touch); mandate_reference (SPO URI for structural validation of requested_action against SO Type); confidence level calibration guidance (CONFIDENCE_MISCALIBRATION_WARNING trigger when >40% of high-confidence IDPs receive DENY/HEM in a 10-IDP window); and RETRY_CONTINUATION normative strengthening with backward reference to AEP-02 what_changed. IDP is what makes agent reasoning auditable at the protocol level: it solves the intent-execution disconnect problem by committing intent to a tamper-evident Event Log before the action occurs.

---

## SECTION 2 — Problem Statement

Without IDP, your governance system can record what an agent did but not why.

Without IDP-05 specifically, your SOOS-governed system has no standardized way to:

- Gate sessions on a pre-session scope commitment — without intake_endorsement, the agent's EOD is an unvalidated claim; IDP-05's intake_endorsement operation produces a GEC-signed Endorsed EOD that is Event-Log-committed before the first SENSE delivery; IDPs without a valid endorsed_eod_id (Class 3) are rejected before Cedar evaluation [NEW in -05]
- Derive governed EODs from natural-language instructions — without PD-EOD, an operator's natural-language instruction cannot become a governed EOD; IDP-05's PD-EOD branch derives a GEC-validated EOD from the prompt while enforcing the scope-bounding rule: no target state outside the SO Type's state machine regardless of prompt content [NEW in -05]
- Validate IDP scope against the governing SO Type structure — without mandate_reference, the IDP's requested_action is validated only by Cedar; IDP-05's mandate_reference field enables structural validation against the SPO URI before Cedar evaluation; IDP_ACTION_OUTSIDE_SPO is detectable before Cedar runs [NEW in -05]
- Detect systematic confidence miscalibration — without the CONFIDENCE_MISCALIBRATION_WARNING, an agent that inflates confidence_level to exploit Cedar policies is undetectable within a session; IDP-05's 10-IDP miscalibration window catches systematic overconfidence and surfaces it via HEM notification and the `agent_miscalibration_active` Cedar attribute [NEW in -05]
- Require substantiated retries — IDP-05 strengthens RETRY_CONTINUATION to require reference to specific DENY enrichment fields; `RETRY_WHAT_CHANGED_WEAK` in the Event Log flags descriptions that lack specificity; what_changed_guidance in the Enriched DENY Response provides field-specific guidance for the next retry [REVISED in -05]

---

## SECTION 3 — Key Normative Concepts

These terms are normative in IDP-05 and must not be paraphrased away:

intake_endorsement operation [NEW in -05]:
   A GEC service invoked before AEP session initiation. Input: EOD + mandate_jwt + principal_credential. Output: Endorsed EOD with endorsed_eod_id, eod_hash, so_id_bound, scope_status (IN_SCOPE / PARTIAL_SCOPE / OUT_OF_SCOPE), primary_outcome_validated, plan_b_validated, endorsed_at, and gec_signature. The GEC records ENDORSED_EOD in the Event Stream before returning the Endorsed EOD. An OUT_OF_SCOPE Endorsed EOD MUST NOT be used to begin a session. Class 3 IDPs without endorsed_eod_id are rejected with IDP_ENDORSED_EOD_REQUIRED.

Endorsed EOD [NEW in -05]:
   The output of the intake_endorsement operation. Distinct from the submitted EOD: the Endorsed EOD carries the GEC's structural validation result and gec_signature. The endorsed_eod_id in the Endorsed EOD is the IDP field that links every per-transition declaration to the pre-session scope commitment. IDP validation checks the ENDORSED_EOD Event Log entry — not the agent-supplied Endorsed EOD — to prevent endorsed_eod_id forgery.

PD-EOD (Prompt-Derived EOD) [NEW in -05]:
   An EOD derived by the GEC from a natural-language source_prompt. Carries derived: true, source_prompt, derivation_model, derivation_confidence, and derivation_warnings. Scope-bounding rule: the PD-EOD MUST NOT declare a target state outside the SO Type's state machine regardless of source_prompt content. External-system touch HEM notification: if a session action touches a system not in the source_prompt or SO Type interaction surface, HEM notification is required before the action executes. Human principal response: APPROVE, REDIRECT_GOAL, or TERMINATE.

mandate_reference [NEW in -05]:
   OPTIONAL SPO URI in the IDP structure. When present, GEC performs structural validation: (a) SPO URI must be resolvable and not expired (IDP_SPO_EXPIRED on expiry); (b) requested_action must be in the SPO action space (IDP_ACTION_OUTSIDE_SPO on violation); (c) SPO must cover the session's so_id SO Type (IDP_SPO_TYPE_MISMATCH on mismatch). Cedar attributes: idp.mandate_reference_valid (boolean).

CONFIDENCE_MISCALIBRATION_WARNING [NEW in -05]:
   GEC-emitted Event Log entry when: within any 10-IDP window, the ratio of IDPs declaring confidence_level >= 0.80 that received DENY or HEM_PENDING exceeds the configured threshold (default 0.40). The warning triggers HEM notification to the human principal with ADVISORY urgency and exposes Cedar attribute context.agent_miscalibration_active = true. Correction mechanism: GEC notifies human principal; Cedar policies MAY apply elevated scrutiny to miscalibrated agents. The miscalibration score is available as Cedar attribute idp.miscalibration_score.

RETRY_CONTINUATION — what_changed alignment [REVISED in -05]:
   The reasoning_basis.description in a RETRY_CONTINUATION IDP MUST reference specific DENY enrichment fields or observable Context Package changes since the denial. This aligns with AEP-02 Section 10.4's what_changed requirement. RETRY_WHAT_CHANGED_WEAK is the IDP-layer Event Log entry (warning, not reject) when the description lacks specificity. what_changed_guidance in the Enriched DENY Response provides field-specific guidance: e.g., "next retry must reference enrichment.confidence_level_required: 0.75 or above." Cedar attribute: idp.prior_denial_count (GEC-derived, not agent-supplied).

New IDP fields [NEW in -05]:
   endorsed_eod_id: UUID of GEC-signed Endorsed EOD. Class 3: REQUIRED. Class 2: RECOMMENDED. Validated against ENDORSED_EOD Event Log entry.
   eod_id: UUID of original (unendorsed) EOD. Audit chain field.
   plan_b_ref: plan_b_id from EOD. REQUIRED when session_state is PLAN_B_ACTIVE.
   mandate_reference: SPO URI for structural validation.

New Cedar context attributes [NEW in -05]:
   idp.has_endorsed_eod: boolean
   idp.eod_scope_status: IN_SCOPE | OUT_OF_SCOPE | PARTIAL_SCOPE
   idp.plan_b_active: boolean
   idp.mandate_reference_valid: boolean
   idp.miscalibration_score: number
   context.agent_miscalibration_active: boolean

New deny codes [NEW in -05]:
   IDP_ENDORSED_EOD_REQUIRED, IDP_ENDORSED_EOD_INVALID, IDP_PLAN_B_REF_REQUIRED, IDP_SPO_EXPIRED, IDP_ACTION_OUTSIDE_SPO, IDP_SPO_TYPE_MISMATCH, INTAKE_PRINCIPAL_UNRECOGNIZED, INTAKE_EOD_MALFORMED, INTAKE_MANDATE_INVALID, INTAKE_PRIMARY_OUTCOME_INVALID, INTAKE_PLAN_B_INVALID, INTAKE_SPO_EXPIRED, INTAKE_DUPLICATE, RETRY_WHAT_CHANGED_WEAK

---

## SECTION 4 — Relationship to Adjacent Standards

AEP-02 (draft-sato-soos-aep-02) [KEY DEPENDENCY - REVISED in -05]:
   AEP-02 introduced the EOD as an AEP-layer concept (Section 6) and the intake_endorsement requirement as a session initiation gate (Section 5.1(d)-(j)). IDP-05 provides the IDP-layer specification of intake_endorsement (Section 4.6), the PD-EOD branch (Section 4.7), and the endorsed_eod_id field that AEP-02's ENDORSED_EOD Event Log entry references. The two drafts are tightly coupled: AEP-02 Section 5.1 requires the intake_endorsement output before session initiation; IDP-05 Section 4.6 specifies what that output is and how it is produced.

GNAP (RFC 9635):
   GNAP establishes the grant before the session. intake_endorsement operates in the window between GNAP grant issuance and first AEP SENSE delivery. GNAP does not address EOD endorsement or pre-session scope commitment. IDP-05's intake_endorsement fills this gap explicitly.

EU AI Act Article 9 (Technical risk management):
   The intake_endorsement Endorsed EOD is the Article 9 pre-session technical risk management artifact for Class 2/3 agents. The CONFIDENCE_MISCALIBRATION_WARNING implements the Article 9 "monitoring throughout the lifecycle" requirement for confidence calibration drift. Together with AEP-02's STALLED state and GAR-03's Session Block, IDP-05 completes the Article 9 risk management cycle: pre-session commitment → per-transition governance → session-level audit.

WIMSE WG:
   The PD-EOD branch (Section 4.7) addresses the WIMSE concern about agents derived from natural-language instructions: the GEC's derivation process produces a machine-verifiable EOD from the prompt, with the scope-bounding rule preventing scope expansion beyond the SO Type's state machine.

---

## SECTION 5 — Normative SOOS Cross-References

This draft depends on:
   AEP (draft-sato-soos-aep-02) — intake_endorsement is the IDP-05 specification of the AEP-02 session initiation gate; endorsed_eod_id in IDP-05 corresponds to EOD commitment in AEP-02 Section 5.1; plan_b_ref in IDP is required when AEP session_state is PLAN_B_ACTIVE; RETRY_CONTINUATION what_changed aligns with AEP-02 Section 10.4
   KIA (draft-sato-soos-kia-03) — principal_credential in intake_endorsement is validated against the KIA Party Registry; gec_instance_id in IDP-05 is the KIA-attested instance identifier; ENDORSED_EOD Event Log entry is GEC-signed using the KIA-registered GEC keypair
   HEM (draft-sato-soos-hem-05) — CONFIDENCE_MISCALIBRATION_WARNING notifies human principal via HEM with ADVISORY urgency; PD-EOD external-system touch triggers HEM notification before first external touch; RETRY_LIMIT_EXCEEDED (deny code) triggers HEM_PENDING via GEC

The following drafts depend on this draft:
   AEP (draft-sato-soos-aep-02) — AEP-02 Section 5.1 references intake_endorsement as the pre-session gate; AEP session_state PLAN_B_ACTIVE requires plan_b_ref in IDP per CONF-AEP-14
   CAP (draft-sato-soos-cap-04) — CAP evaluates IDP's declared action against prohibition tiers before Cedar; endorsed_eod_id validates that the IDP is within a pre-committed scope before CAP sees it
   GAR (draft-sato-soos-gar-03) — GAR records IDP_SUBMITTED, ENDORSED_EOD, CEDAR_DENY_RECORDED, ACTION_RESULT_RECORDED, IDP_COMMITMENT_VERIFIED, CONFIDENCE_MISCALIBRATION_WARNING; endorsed_eod_id in SAR links session to pre-session commitment

Changes from -04 to -05:

   PD-EOD branch (Section 4.7) — derived: true flag; scope-bounding rule; external-system touch HEM notification
   mandate_reference field (Section 4.1) — SPO URI; structural validation; three new deny codes
   Confidence level calibration guidance (Section 7) — CONFIDENCE_MISCALIBRATION_WARNING trigger; correction mechanism; Cedar attributes
   RETRY_CONTINUATION strengthened (Section 4.3) — what_changed alignment with AEP-02; RETRY_WHAT_CHANGED_WEAK log entry; what_changed_guidance in Enriched DENY Response
   Four new Security Considerations (Sections 9.11-9.14)
   IANA: IDP Operation Codes registry (intake_endorsement); PD-EOD Derivation Flags registry; 14 new deny codes
   Updated normative references: AEP-02, HEM-05, KIA-03

Target WG engagement at IETF 126 Vienna (July 18–24, 2026):
   OAUTH WG — IDP-05's intake_endorsement fills the gap between GNAP grant and first agent action; discussion of SPO URI and mandate_reference as an OAUTH-compatible scope binding mechanism
   WIMSE WG — PD-EOD branch addresses WIMSE concern about natural-language-driven agent workload identity; IDP endorsed_eod_id as workload credential binding for pre-session commitment
   ACP BoF — IDP-05 is the IDP-layer complement to AEP-02's EOD; the intake_endorsement → endorsed_eod_id → IDP chain is the pre-session governance pattern the ACP BoF should standardize
